Art Deco hits Minimalism.

Especially the late 1920s and 1930s remain endlessly inspiring to me.
There was already a sense of reduction and clarity —
but interiors still felt rich in atmosphere, sensuality and depth.

Dark woods. Glossy surfaces. Stainless steel.
Minimal, yet warm and full of character.

Somehow, minimalism later became too cold, empty and lifeless.
We want to bring the atmosphere back.

— Vera
